newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN refugee agency investigating staff member.
newsitem.headline: UN refugee agency investigating staff member.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR said on Friday it was investigating allegations that a senior official distributed obscene drawings of colleagues.
UNHCR spokeswoman Pamela O'Toole said the agency was also studying assertions in Swiss newspapers that he wrote to young girls in Asia, Latin America and eastern Europe to try to lure them to Geneva.

O'Toole was speaking at a news briefing after two Geneva dailies published detailed allegations against the man, whom they identified as a 47-year-old citizen of a Middle Eastern state, married with five children.

She confirmed that the man was the subject of an internal investigation over the drawings -- which the newspapers said portrayed other senior UNHCR officers in compromising positions and were sent anonymously to other staff last February.

Diplomatic sources said the man had been put on special leave with full pay for three months earlier this year while the allegations were investigated and was now on sick leave. No criminal charges have been filed.
